node.title: Budget-three fiber-two cycles route through three quartic-pencil strata
node.statement: Every direct common-X^2 four-cycle construction descends through Y=X^2 to four pairwise-coprime degree-(s-1) members of a two-dimensional pencil with a squarefree quartic denominator D_*; the completion roots are automatically distinct. The number c=0,1,2 of antipodal deleted-root pairs is exhaustive. For c=0, D_*=product_i(Y-rho_i^2), giving exactly the existing matched antipodal quotient-pencil input at d_ant=2d=4s. For c=1,2, one or two repeated coefficient-square roots are replaced by exceptional-pair squares, producing explicit denominator-mismatch strata. All three have a Mobius weld, primitive rational-map degree s-1, and the general quartic degree floor. At the prize maximum the quotient order is 2^40, map degree 2^38-1, and lower pencil degree at least 2^37-2. No stratum is proved empty.
